prompt.alinti: This open source project is number one trending in the world right now. It's basically a free version of GrokBot that works with any AI model. GrokBot is awesome. It lets you spin up a whole team of AI agents that actually do the work for you. But let's be honest, there's one big problem here. Once you start using it, you're stuck using Grok's models and they're nowhere near the frontier right now. So if you want the most powerful models from OpenAI Anthropic powering your agent team, you've got two choices. Either build complex team agent infrastructure yourself or use something pre-built like this Paperclip open source project. Paperclip is exploding in popularity right now. It's at 90,000 stars on GitHub and it gives you four key things that let you run an agent team with any model. You can even bring your existing OpenAI or Anthropic subscription. Number one is the task manager. This is where you can literally set any task for your agent and watch the work being done and review it as it happens. Number two is the org chart where you set up your team and establish roles and responsibilities. Number three is a training area. This is where you can assign skills to each your agents and then test them. It's like a performance review for your agents. And number four is the operating system underneath where you configure which models power your agent team. So if you've wanted to try GrokBot but don't love the idea of paying for your own subscription or using and being stuck with the Grok models, comment 'TEAM' and I'll DM you the step-by-step setup to run your own agent team with Paperclip.
